name: mait-mvp
description: Upload contracts → extract text → chunk → embed → analyze with local Ollama LLM.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run stop:ports && npm run dev
scripts.db:vector: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -d mvp -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;" -c "ALTER TABLE \"Chunk\" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS embedding vector(768);" -c "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_embedding ON \"Chunk\" USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops);"
scripts.local:setup: npm run db:up && npm run prisma:deploy && npm run db:vector
scripts.local: npm run local:setup && npm run dev
